---
title: "Contact"
---

Send me a message!

```{=html}

<form method="POST" action="https://formspree.io/f/xeedqbrq">
  <p>
  <label for="name">Your Name:&nbsp;</label>
  <input id="name" type="text" name="name" class="myform" required />
  </p>

  <p>
  <label for="email">Your Email:&nbsp;&nbsp;</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" name="email" class="myform" required />
  </p>

  <p>
  <label for="message">Message:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<textarea id=message name="message" rows="10" class="myform" ></textarea></label>
  </p>

  <p>
  <button type="submit">Send Message</button>
  </p>
</form>
```
